name: rll/surgical (DOOSim)
what_it_is: A research simulator for deformable one-dimensional objects (DOOs) such as surgical suture, rope, and hair, based on the Discrete Elastic Rods model, intended to support perception, manipulation, and motion planning for robotic surgical assistants.
protocols: UDP sockets for haptic device state exchange
UDP sockets for Raven II robot commands
constraints: Ubuntu 10.10+ and Mac OS X only; requires Eigen2, OpenCV 2.1, GLUT, GLE, Bullet Physics, Boost
Abandoned in 2011; no license file; no package manager; raw Makefile only
notable_absences: No tissue/organ simulation; 1D thread objects only
